text:
Maya: noticed another kv-cache alert burst at 03:40 UTC, pages fired. opening follow-up thread. incident: https://incidents/redwood/9932
Dan: same pattern as last time, multiple pages within short window. looks like dedupe window not catching bursts.
Kevin: paste the alert rule pls.
Maya: rule:
```
alert: kvcache_high_errors
expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_errors_total[1m])) by (shard) > 50
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kvcache
```
Sophia: quick fixes: increase eval window to 5m and dedupe on deployment+shard. also consider switching transient bursts to ticket.
Nate: propose suppression: if same stacktrace/identity fires >3x in 6m, collapse to single page and mute for 10m. escalate on sustained >10m.
Tara: I can own the alert change + dashboard for 5m rates. will push staging PR today (ETA 2h).
Maya: assign Tara impl, Kevin review, Maya validate. plan: PR today, staging test, prod roll tomorrow morning.
Kevin: will review in ~3h. suggest making severity togglable per environment.
IncidentBot: alert kvcache_high_errors triggered 2026-03-01T03:40:12Z -> pages:4, resolved 2026-03-01T03:53:21Z, incident: https://incidents.redwood/9932
Tara: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/460 — changes: for:5m, dedupe labels include deployment, suppression logic, severity toggle. CI green.
Kevin: reviewing, minor label name nit, otherwise LGTM.
Maya: post-deploy checklist: merge PR, monitor staging 6h, gradual prod rollout (10/30/60), update runbook with paging policy, add telemetry metric for "pages avoided by dedupe".
Tara: merged, rolling to staging.
Maya: staging 90m clean, starting prod rollout.
Dan: prod at 100% with no new pages.
Nate: created ops ticket for deploy smoke test: https://issues.redwood/ops/3245, ETA sprint end.
Sophia: proposed paging policy for runbook: if alert resolves <10m -> ticket, >=10m -> page, immediate page for verified high-severity signals, document exceptions.
Maya: summarizing actions/owners and updating postmortem. will review noise metrics in 7 days. :white_check_mark:
